# Scope statement

Organisation: Example Ltd
Version and date: 1.0, 2026-03-01

## Boundary

Sites, teams and systems the management system covers: The head office, the platform team and the hosted inference service run from the production cloud account.

## In scope

Services, processes and assets that are included: Model training pipeline, inference service, customer support tooling and the staff laptops used for them.

## Out of scope

What is excluded, with the reason for each exclusion: Office guest network and the pilot lab are out of scope because they hold no customer data.

## Interfaces and dependencies

Outside parties or systems the scope relies on: The cloud hosting provider and the identity provider.
